claim: All USA Ballots Arriving After Election Day Will Be Thrown Out
justification: The claim that all USA ballots arriving after Election Day will be thrown out is explicitly refuted by high-confidence evidence. The Uniformed and Overseas Citizens Absentee Voting Act (UOCAVA), with a confidence score of 0.90, mandates that states count late-arriving ballots from overseas and military voters, contradicting the absolute nature of the claim. Additionally, evidence with confidence scores of 0.90 and above confirms that in the 2020 election, states like California, Pennsylvania, and North Carolina legally accepted and counted mail-in ballots postmarked by Election Day but received after Election Day, demonstrating that exceptions existed and not all such ballots were discarded.
